student_answer: Artificial Intelligence is the field of building computer systems that perform tasks associated with human intelligence. It can learn from examples and improve its behaviour from data. AI systems can reason and support decision making. They can solve problems instead of following only one fixed sequence of instructions. AI can understand language and recognize patterns in text, images, or other data.

Machine Learning is a branch of AI in which models learn from data. The model identifies useful patterns or relationships in training data. Those learned patterns are used to make predictions or decisions on new inputs. The system is not explicitly programmed with a separate hard-coded rule for every case. Training examples are used to adjust the model so its performance can improve.

Natural Language Processing is an area of AI that enables computers to work with human language. It processes and analyzes human-written or spoken language. NLP can perform text classification and sentiment analysis. It is used for machine translation and question answering. Semantic representations can be used to measure text similarity and meaning.

Cloud computing delivers computing resources and services over the internet. Services can include storage, databases, servers, networking, and software. Users access these resources through the internet without maintaining all physical hardware themselves. Resources can be scaled up or down according to demand. It improves flexibility and accessibility from different locations or devices.

A Database Management System is software for storing, organizing, managing, and retrieving data. It supports efficient storage, organization, querying, and retrieval of records. A DBMS helps maintain data accuracy, integrity, and consistency. It provides security and controlled access to sensitive information. It can support many users and applications while reducing unnecessary duplication of data.
